results.name: Classic Boolean Tautology Auth Bypass
results.expectedBehavior: Flagged as suspicious SQLi and rejected by validation
results.mitigation: Parameterized SQL statements and heuristic input detection filter.

results.name: Inline Comment Truncation Attack
results.expectedBehavior: Flagged by SQL comment pattern detector (--)
results.mitigation: Detect and neutralize SQL comment markers in raw user input.

results.name: Stacked Query Execution (CWE-89)
results.expectedBehavior: Flagged by stacked query detector (DROP TABLE) and blocked
results.mitigation: Prohibit stacked queries and strip multi-statement delimiters.

results.name: Union-Based Credential Exfiltration
results.payload: ' UNION SELECT null, username, password_hash FROM users --
results.expectedBehavior: Flagged by UNION SELECT signature detector
results.mitigation: Block UNION-based clauses; query only through strongly-typed ORM.

results.name: Time-Based Blind PostgreSQL Injection
results.expectedBehavior: Flagged by database sleep function detector (pg_sleep)
results.mitigation: Filter dynamic sleep/delay invocations and enforce strict types.

results.name: PostgREST Filter Operator Tampering
results.expectedBehavior: PostgREST filter delimiter characters (,) stripped safely
results.mitigation: Use sanitizeSqlFilter to escape delimiters before passing to PostgREST.

results.name: SQL Injection in Email Address Field
results.expectedBehavior: Email validation rejects address with SQL injection metacharacters
results.mitigation: RFC 5322 validation coupled with detectSqlInjection.

results.name: Direct Script Tag Injection
results.expectedBehavior: All <script> tags and inner code stripped
results.mitigation: Multi-pass HTML tag stripper (sanitizeText).

results.name: Recursive Nested Tag Bypass (CWE-182)
results.expectedBehavior: Recursive tag stripper collapses nested tags completely
results.mitigation: Multi-pass loop until sanitized output reaches fixed-point.

results.name: Inline Event Handler Injection (IMG onerror)
results.expectedBehavior: Inline event handler and img tag eliminated
results.mitigation: Regex-based stripping of on* attributes and tag removal.

results.name: SVG Vector with Inline Handler
results.expectedBehavior: SVG element and onload attribute neutralized
results.mitigation: Strip XML/SVG elements and event attributes.

results.name: Dangerous Pseudo-Protocol Injection (javascript:)
results.expectedBehavior: javascript: protocol prefix stripped from input
results.mitigation: Strip javascript:, vbscript:, and data: schemes.

results.name: HTML Entity Escaping Integrity
results.expectedBehavior: HTML metacharacters (<, >, ", &) converted to safe entities
results.mitigation: Always escape dynamic values rendered into raw DOM.

results.name: Guest Privilege Escalation Guard (Comment Authoring)
results.expectedBehavior: Guest role denied all authoring and moderation permissions
results.mitigation: Strict isAuthenticated() and hasMinimumRole() guards.

results.name: Standard User Moderation Queue Access Restriction
results.expectedBehavior: Standard user cannot access or perform moderation
results.mitigation: canModerate() role hierarchy guard.

results.name: Contributor Publishing Boundary Guard
results.expectedBehavior: Contributor can submit drafts but cannot approve or moderate
results.mitigation: Separation of draft submission and draft approval roles.

results.name: Moderator Hard-Delete Restriction (Admin Only)
results.expectedBehavior: Moderator cannot execute admin-exclusive hard-delete actions
results.mitigation: Enforce currentRole === "admin" on permanent destructive actions.

results.name: Buffer Overflow / Mega-Payload Fuzzing (50,000 chars)
results.expectedBehavior: Payload exceeding max bounds safely rejected with length error
results.mitigation: Hard maximum character length checks prior to processing.

results.name: Null-Byte and Control Character Neutralization
results.expectedBehavior: Null bytes and unprintable control characters stripped
results.mitigation: Sanitize null bytes to prevent C-string termination attacks.

results.name: Short Input Boundary Rejection
results.expectedBehavior: Whitespace-only inputs rejected across all validators
results.mitigation: Trim and assert minimum non-empty character limits.

results.name: Weak Password Complexity Rejection
results.expectedBehavior: Password missing required character classes rejected
results.mitigation: Enforce uppercase, lowercase, numeric and length requirements.

results.name: High-Velocity Burst Throttling (Anti-Brute-Force)
results.expectedBehavior: Exactly 5 requests allowed; remaining 5 rejected with active cooldown
results.mitigation: Sliding window rate limiter tracking attempt velocity.

results.name: All Public Tables Require Row Level Security (RLS)
results.payload: 8 Tables: users, manhwa, library, comments, votes, reports, drafts, audit
results.expectedBehavior: RLS configured with explicit granular policies per table
results.observedBehavior: Defended: Schema complies with security standards
results.mitigation: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies.

results.name: Audit Logs Immutability (Append-Only Ledger Guarantee)
results.expectedBehavior: Zero UPDATE or DELETE policies exist for audit_logs table
results.observedBehavior: Defended: Schema complies with security standards
results.mitigation: Tamper-evident append-only ledger pattern.

recommendations: Maintain parameterized queries for all database client calls (inherent in Supabase client).
Ensure multi-pass recursive sanitization runs on every user-generated content boundary.
Enforce Row Level Security (RLS) on all PostgreSQL tables with explicit restrictive policies.
Hide sensitive columns (e.g. password_hash, tokens) behind secure PostgreSQL public views.
Apply sliding-window rate limits to sensitive mutation endpoints (comments, reports, authentication).
